name: billing
description: Payments with Stripe: a pricing page, plans you edit in one file, subscriptions, and a billing section in Settings.

envExample.name: STRIPE_SECRET_KEY
envExample.comment:
Payments (Stripe). Your secret key: starts with sk_test_ while you try things out.
Server only. Never put NEXT_PUBLIC_ in front of it.

envExample.name: STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET
envExample.comment: Payments (Stripe). Lets the app trust Stripe's messages. The Stripe setup in Shipyard fills this in.

envExample.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY
envExample.comment: Payments (Stripe). Public key. Optional: the built-in payment page does not need it.

envExample.name: STRIPE_PORTAL_CONFIGURATION
envExample.comment: Payments (Stripe). Optional: which customer portal settings to use. The Stripe setup in Shipyard fills this in.

patches.note: Show the billing section in Settings: add <BillingSection /> (from @/components/billing/BillingSection) inside the page. The page /settings/billing works either way.
Add the payments checks to the Health page: spread billingHealthChecks (from @/lib/billing/health) into the list of checks.

patches.entry: { id: "billing-cancel-subscription", label: "cancel your subscription", run: cancelBillingOnDelete }
patches.note: Cancel the Stripe subscription when someone deletes their account: add cancelBillingOnDelete (from @/lib/billing/pre-delete) to the list of things done before an account is deleted.

next: Edit the plans in src/lib/billing/plans.ts (name, price, what each plan includes).
Run the Stripe setup (stripe-setup.mjs) in test mode: it makes the products, prices, customer portal and webhook in Stripe.
In the Stripe dashboard, Settings, Business, Public details: add your Terms link (your site address plus /terms). Checkout needs it for the "I agree" box.
Update your privacy policy and terms for payments: run legal-generate.mjs again.
Try a payment with the test card 4242 4242 4242 4242, then look at the admin Health page.
